title: The phone spots an unreachable erase by matching the engine's words, so rewording them misreports the erase
evidence: ios/HealthRoadmap/MyData/EraseText.swift:74 contains("could not be reached") vs record-session.ts:76 ERASE_UNREACHABLE; DataEraserTests:250 checks the substring only. Engine should return a kind. iPhone survey 2026-11-11 (main fcc4ed9b) L3
